title: Menu bar
description: A toolbar of tools and formatting options. Icons morph into place as you pick a tool or list style, and play when pressed.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: One tool
fragments.note: A real radio underneath keeps the tools usable from the keyboard; the icon follows it.

fragments.title: One list button
fragments.note: The icon follows aria-pressed directly, with no code in between.

fragments.title: One action button
fragments.note: No attribute to follow: nothing about it changes after a press.

fragments.title: Copy the radio's choice into an attribute
fragments.note: checked is a property, and nothing can watch a property.

fragments.title: One kind of list or none
fragments.note: Pressing one list button releases the other; pressing it again releases it.

fragments.title: The selected tool
fragments.note: The resting, hovered and selected looks, icon colour included.
